items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Lawrence Morera and Joe Saia... He helped me and Lawrence and the rest of the show to play the music.

ctx.x: Yeah, Lawrence Morera and Joe Saia. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Who was Bush? Bush was a trumpet player. He was a fine trumpet player. He came up under Buddy P.T. Buddy P.T. was his instructor. He was the only one in the band who could read music. He helped me and Lawrence and the rest of the show to play the music. So I in turn helped Ray Allen. Yeah.
What was Bush's name? Bush Hall.
